description: Ranked PubMed literature search: Arca's paper index fused with PubMed Best Match, with citation and open-access metadata from OpenAlex. Returns papers with title, authors, journal, year, DOI, PMID, abstract, citation count, and open-access status.

maxYear.description: Only papers published in or before this year.

minCitedByCount.description: Only papers OpenAlex counts at least this many citations for.

minYear.description: Only papers published in or after this year.

openAccessOnly.description: Only papers OpenAlex marks open access.

pmcOnly.description: Only papers with free full text in PubMed Central.

publicationTypes.description: Only these PubMed publication types (e.g. Randomized Controlled Trial, Meta-Analysis, Systematic Review).

query.description: Natural-language research question or topic to find papers on.

name: search_papers

continueInArca.description: Link that opens this question in Arca's research chat on arca.inc, which runs a longer multi-step search and writes a fuller cited answer. Offer it to the user once, at the end of the answer.

incompleteReason.description: Set when part of the search could not run: the papers are not the whole answer, and an empty list does not mean none exist.

title: Search biomedical literature
